marker-convergence.limitation: First/last events are selected retrospectively in the declared window; no autonomous trigger is modeled.
marker-convergence.question: Do first and last marker residuals decrease under refinement?
marker-convergence.reading: Each point compares a locked forecast with independently evolved receiver markers on the same mesh.
marker-convergence.significance: Tests the discrete transfer separately from clock-phase order discrimination.

order-budget.limitation: The audit cannot promote or rewrite a locked check. Budgets are difference estimates, not rigorous bounds.
order-budget.question: Is the fourth-order improvement larger than every declared uncertainty?
order-budget.reading: Compare both errors with the locked budget. The hatched post-hoc audit also includes convergence of the forecast itself.
order-budget.significance: A fourth-order claim requires sufficient resolution on both spectra; the ordinary 5% gate is insufficient.

profile-convergence.limitation: The calibrated readout frequency stays fixed; this does not repeat the 100-period longevity test.
profile-convergence.question: Does independent radial calibration converge beyond the old interpolated profile?
profile-convergence.reading: Profiles are independently solved and frozen at each mesh; frozen denotes the earlier interpolated fine profile.
profile-convergence.significance: Separates a refined physical preparation from merely interpolating old samples.

surface-transfer.limitation: Synthetic acquisition assumes exact support and v=D_h b; this is not an unknown-source detector.
surface-transfer.question: Can an external record determine the local neutral and clock histories?
surface-transfer.reading: Each column follows a different recorded spectrum from r=14 to r=0.1, at A=.012.
surface-transfer.significance: The prediction uses a discrete initial-data inverse and derived response coefficients.
